decisions.rule: Use the top-level account XRP balance field only for current account balance. Child-account 'Activated ... XRP' rows describe activation events and must never be parsed as the parent account's current balance.

Record page retrieval timestamp, top-level balance field, explorer URL and dynamic-page limitation. If a later read changes a prior estimate, append an erratum snapshot and limitation; never overwrite the earlier artifact.
Report current source-wallet balances separately from historical incident transfer amounts. A tiny residual balance is not a complete customer-liability or PoR calculation.
